The dish looks like scrambled eggs with greens, probably spinach or arugula, plus a bit of tomato and possibly cheese. The plate is white and round, spanning roughly 400 px of the image. I'm treating it as a dinner plate of about 26 cm, which gives about 0.065 cm per pixel.

The food pile covers roughly 230 px by 200 px, or about 15 cm by 13 cm. That is a moderate area, and scrambled eggs are fluffy, so the layer is probably about 2-3 cm thick.

For volume, an ellipse of about 15 × 13 cm has an area of roughly 150 cm². At an average thickness of about 1.5 cm, that is about 225 cm³. Scrambled egg with air pockets has a density of roughly 0.6-0.7 g/cm³, so the mass comes to about 150 g.

Scrambled eggs with oil or butter run about 1.6 kcal/g, and the greens and cheese change that little. That gives about 240 kcal, which I'll round up slightly to 250.
